Name: AutoCombat
Author: YunHikari
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
[list]
[*]Automatically switches to the leftmost [b][color=#cfe2f3]Melee Weapon[/color][/b] in the toolbar and counters when an enemy approaches.
[*]After automatically switching, choose to continue with auto-attack or switch to manual attack based on your style.
[*]It will predict if an attack on vanilla monsters would be ineffective, such as when a Grub is evolving, a Rock Crab is hiding in a rock, or a Mummy is reviving. In these cases, the attack will not trigger.
[*]Intelligently automatically performs weapon [b][color=#cfe2f3]Special Moves[/color][/b].
[*]Make the [b][color=#cfe2f3]Slingshot[/color][/b] easier to operate and responsive to melee actions.
[*]Auto-Targeting allows you to clear an entire mine level without any manual actions.
[*]If a weapon enchanted with Crusader is in the toolbar, it will be prioritized for attacking Mummies.
[*]If a weapon enchanted with Bug Killer is in the toolbar, it will be prioritized for attacking Armored Bugs.
[/list][b]
How to use : [color=#f1c232]Melee Weapon[/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Place the melee weapon in any position on the toolbar, and the mod will use the leftmost melee weapon available.
[*]Approach any enemy that can take effective damage.
[/list][b]
How to use : [color=#f1c232]Smart Slingshot[/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Place any slingshot in the toolbar and ensure it is loaded with ammunition.
[*]Set the hotkey for [color=#6aa84f][b]"Slingshot Manual Hotkey"[/b][/color] in GMCM.
[*]You can use the slingshot regardless of which tool your toolbar index is on.
[*]After using the slingshot, the toolbar index will return to your originally selected item.
[/list]
[b]How to use : [color=#f1c232]Auto-Targeting[/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Toggle "Auto Targeting" in GMCM.
[*]Ensure "Continuous Auto Attack" and "Auto Switch Melee Weapon" are toggled.
[*]Have any melee weapon equipped in the toolbar.
[/list]
[b]Configs[/b]
[list]
[*]You can customize this mod using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[*]You can enable [color=#6aa84f][b]"ContinuousAutoAttack"[/b][/color] in GMCM to switch between automatic and manual attacks after drawing your weapon.
[*]And then you'll find more combinations in GCMC...
[/list]
[b][color=#ffd966][size=4]After the 1.1.0 update, you can clear an entire dungeon floor without any input (optional).[/size][/color][/b]

However, this video is paired with my other mod, '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28666]AutoPickaxe[/url]'.
